summary:
The central claim is still unproven in the repo's own build: that the shipped Scanner and SynchronousIoCancel work on a real cloud-filter folder. The stall Fact and the tree Fact register a real cldflt sync root. Design open question 1 asks whether that may happen on this PC, and nobody has answered it, so I did not run them. Criteria 1, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 have never run as the repo's own tests. The only real contact for them is SL-049's risk spike, which ran in a scratch copy.

Everything that does not register a root, I ran or read:
- **Build:** the solution builds with the repo-local SDK 10.0.401 with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
- **Default suite:** 332 passed, 0 failed. The trx contains 0 CloudPlaceholderTests and 0 StalledShareTests, so the Trait gate plus the csproj filter keeps the opt-in tests out.
- **Opt-in listing:** `--list-tests --filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT` selects exactly the 4 gated Facts.
- **Non-registering gated Facts:** both AProviderThatCannotStart Facts pass. Windows answers 'ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002' with exit 2, the silent provider is killed at 2 s with its stderr in the failure, and teardown takes 1–2 ms. There were no fsa-cf-* folders in %TEMP% before or after.
- **Baked default filter:** the assembly holds `DefaultTestFilter=Network!=TEST-NET-1&Network!=SMB-LOOPBACK&Cloud!=CF-SYNC-ROOT`.
- **Rules:** Fitness op=check reports all 50 rules hold. rules-parity reports AGREE with 35 settled entries.
- **RuleCases:** C-001 and C-003 fail on the stale '28 settled entries' pin. I confirmed they fail the same way at base 0647ead (32 entries there), so this failure predates the slice.

Two fix obligations from code review, owed to build-slice, are still open in the tree. There has been only one build attempt, and code review passed while raising them.
- **O-024:** SyncRootRig.Dispose (CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:405-433) still writes no CANCEL_FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS count and no captured provider lines before the kill. A passing run therefore cannot show whether FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS was still pending when the provider was killed.
- **O-025:** TheSweepRemovesOnlyTheRootOfARunThatIsGone (CloudRigTests.cs:43-85) still has no junction.
  - I ran a scratch probe of that shape. A junction named like a dead-pid root, pointing at a folder outside the tree, passes at HEAD: the sweep skips it.
  - I then removed the `LinkTarget is not null` check in the scratch copy. All 26 CloudRigTests stayed green and only my probe failed. So the gap O-025 names is real.

Criteria 13 and 14 are met as the design decided: no partial-hydration arm and no no-cancel stall Fact exist. Nothing needs administrator rights, so I request no elevation. The blocker is a person's decision, not a privilege.

criteria.criterion: 1. cancel a scan stalled on a cloud folder: 'stall' (flags NONE, FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS never answered), cancelled 3 s in, with 'ok' (3 files) listed before it
criteria.how: StalledFetchIsFreedByCancelThroughTheShippedGuard exists (CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:65-118) but was not run, because it registers a real sync root and open question 1 is unanswered. The only real contact is spike 1 (conditional, 32 ms, run in a scratch copy).

criteria.criterion: 2. match provider callbacks to the scan: callback lines from other pids on the same root
criteria.how: CloudRigTests.OnlyThisProcesssCallbacksCountAsTheScans passed in the default run (332/332). It feeds pid+1, pid*10+1, pid*10, pid+2 and pid 0, and paths with spaces. Synthetic lines only (code contact).

criteria.criterion: 3. cancel does not free the scan: still running 5 s after cts.Cancel() because the guard regressed
criteria.how: CloudRigTests.AScanCancelDoesNotFreeIsFreedByForceAndFails passed in the default run. The shipped Scanner uses an uninterruptible BeforeCall stand-in, and ScanDeadline forces it and fails. It is a stand-in, not a real cldflt block.

criteria.criterion: 4. report a cancelled stalled folder: 'stall' after a Cancelled scan
criteria.how: Asserted only inside the unrun stall Fact (lines 113-116): an empty Folder, not in Unreadable. Spike 1 measured this; the repo's own test has not run. Open question 2 (whether this is acceptable) is also unanswered.

criteria.criterion: 5. start the provider: ERR and exit 2, or silent with no READY
criteria.how: Ran both AProviderThatCannotStart Facts: 'ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002', exit 2, in ~101 ms; the silent provider was killed at the 2 s override with its stderr in the failure. A missing folder stands in for non-NTFS %TEMP% or an absent cldflt.

criteria.criterion: 6. tear down after a killed provider: provider killed while 'stall' is unpopulated and FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS is pending, then re-run three times
criteria.how: Needs the real opt-in run three times, which was not run (open question 1). O-024 is still open: on a passing run the pending request is withdrawn by Cancel before the kill, and Dispose records nothing that shows which shape was torn down. Spike 4 (go) ran the shape on a stand-in only.

criteria.criterion: 7. sweep stale sync roots: a leftover fsa-cf root from a crashed testhost, next to look-alike names
criteria.how: TheSweepRemovesOnlyTheRootOfARunThatIsGone and TheSweepGoesOnWhenAnUnregisterFails passed in the default run, with an injected unregister (not a real registered root). Caveat, O-025: no test covers a junction carrying a root's name. My scratch probe shows the behaviour is right at HEAD, but removing the check leaves all 26 CloudRigTests green.

criteria.criterion: 8. size dehydrated cloud placeholders (5 MiB, 12345 B, 3 MiB nested, population disabled)
criteria.how: DehydratedPlaceholdersAreTraversedWithTrueSizesAndNeverHydrated was not run (it registers a sync root). The only real contact is spike 2 (go).

criteria.criterion: 9. count a hardlink among placeholders (b/f4-link.bin, HardLink ALLOWED)
criteria.how: This is in the unrun tree Fact's UNMEASURED section (lines 171-189). No spike measured it either (m6).

criteria.criterion: 10. hydration regression: FETCH_DATA from the testhost pid, or a placeholder losing RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS
criteria.how: This is in the unrun tree Fact. The only real contact is spike 3 (go: 0 FETCH_DATA over 9 scans).

criteria.criterion: 11. run the default suite: dotnet test with no --filter
criteria.how: 332 passed, 0 failed. The trx shows 0 CloudPlaceholderTests and 0 StalledShareTests executed.

criteria.criterion: 12. guard against a Trait missing from the default filter
criteria.how: OptInTraitTests (10 tests) passed in the default run. The baked DefaultTestFilter read from the assembly carries all three clauses. The Theory covers a missing clause, OR, parentheses, longer and shorter values, and ad-hoc filters.

criteria.criterion: 13. partial hydration arm (1 MiB of 8 MiB): the design judged it not worth a test
criteria.how: As decided (material: false): CfProvider accepts only stall|tree|silent (Program.cs:59) and no Fact hydrates part of a file.

criteria.criterion: 14. stall without cancel until a timeout: the design judged it not worth a test
criteria.how: As decided (material: false): the only stall Fact always cancels (line 85), and the tree Fact's 30 s CancelAfter is a bound, not a stall assertion.

obligations.evidence: Open and owed to build-slice. CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:405-433: Dispose writes only 'teardown took N ms' plus step failures. No CANCEL_FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS count and no Captured() before the kill, and no kill-while-pending stall variant. index.json shows a single build attempt (b331eb1), so no build has run since code review raised it.

Open and owed to build-slice. CloudRigTests.cs:43-85 has no junction case. In a scratch copy, a probe with a junction named fsa-cf-<deadpid>-<hex> passes at HEAD, so the behaviour is right today. With the LinkTarget check removed, all 26 CloudRigTests still pass and only the probe fails (swept = [stale, junction]). That is exactly the gap the obligation names.

not_reached: The stall Fact on a real cldflt sync root: whether the shipped SynchronousIoCancel frees a scan blocked on an unanswered FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS in the repo's own build (criterion 1, Derived 3). Not run because open question 1 (may a sync root be registered on this PC) is unanswered. No admin is needed; a person's decision is.
The tree Fact on a real sync root: true sizes, 0 on disk, zero FETCH_DATA from the testhost, and RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS kept after the scan (criteria 8, 10).
The hardlink-among-placeholders assertions (criterion 9). Neither a spike nor the repo's test has measured them.
Teardown after a killed provider, three runs in a row on real roots (criterion 6). Even if run, O-024 means a passing run would not show whether FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS was still pending at the kill.
The real CfUnregisterSyncRoot plus recursive delete in the sweep, against a genuinely stale registered root. The default tests inject the unregister.
eng/rules-harness/harness.py cross-engine agreement on the new InteropLivesOnlyInNative exemptions and the widened SL-049 settled patterns. It needs the TAAD engine interpreter.
Behaviour with a provider that answers late or with an error, and a kill freeing a scan blocked on a pending FETCH_DATA (M2). No stage measured either.
